wrong credentials show the error and stay on /login

no page threw
sharing with an unknown email shows `No such user` and shares nothing
a shared todo appears under `Shared with me`, server-rendered, with no delete button
a hydrated shared list fetches nothing
the recipient toggles it without a reload; the owner sees it
the owner's toggle reaches the recipient's list on their next load
a third user can't read, toggle or share it, by any id

unshare removes it; the recipient can no longer toggle it
